desc:
cdcarr.dev is the website you are on right now, created to showcase information about myself and my work. It is designed to work as a digital portfolio for employers to be able to see what I have worked on, rather than just read what is listed on my resume.
The website is a single page application, due to it's simple and lightweight nature. Some smaller libraries used include react-hash-browser to manage the pages and react-select for the projects filter bar.
details:
This project was only started in early August, so it is rather fresh in development. I have also opted to do as much myself as I am reasonably able to do, as that provides me with more experience using the base tools. While I have worked with React and Vite before, this was the first time I had created a website from scratch, so it has taken a bit to build out each aspect, and keep older parts updated to my evolving standards.
This website is visually rough currently as it is a work in progress, only started recently and with little spare time to work on it between jobs. It is being updated with new functionality and improved visuals as I have the time to add them.
This website is not currently designed for use on mobile devices, but will be updated in the future.
